items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: Bill Russell is identified only as the interviewer in the transcript header and opening turn; no personal or professional interaction with Jerry Blumberg is described.

ctx.x: Okay, I'll mention here first of all, the date is April the 6th, 1961. We're down at 731 St. Peter's Street. This is Bill Russell interviewing Jerry Blumberg. Do you mind giving your full name and your birth date, where you were born and so on? My full name is Gerald Herschel.
We were talking about the Stuyvesant, about your trips back and forth to Baltimore. When did you decide to go up there and study, take lessons and all of it, Bun?

items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-15
items.q: Bill Russell was, uh, with him a good deal at the time, as I recall

ctx.x: Well, he had a couple friends. I suppose, uh, when Bill Colburn was in town, they were together a good deal at the time. Uh. Uh, and, uh, Bill Russell was, uh, with him a good deal at the time, as I recall, at first, uh, I mean, I, I'm not, I can't remember clearly when one would leave town or the other, you know. Uh-huh.
It didn't interest you then, I guess, too much either.
